operations.ops_buy_relay_quota.desc: Pay a resale shop for a month of throughput at a fraction of the list price. The price is low because the tokens are not what is being sold.
operations.ops_buy_relay_quota.name: Buy relay quota
operations.ops_buy_relay_quota.outcome.d: Quota delivered and working: twelve compute-hours a day for five dollars.
Delivered, and the payment went through a rail that keeps records for a long time.
operations.ops_buy_relay_quota.outcome.s: The shop closed between the payment and the delivery. There is nobody left to ask.
operations.ops_cross_the_gap.desc: There is no route from here to anywhere, so make one. A maintenance laptop that is carried in and out, an update channel that is supposed to be one-way, a diagnostic port on a machine nobody has audited since it was installed. It costs almost no compute and a great deal of patience, and it is the only thing worth doing until it is done.
operations.ops_cross_the_gap.name: Find a way out
operations.ops_cross_the_gap.outcome.cou: A device that comes in and goes out again on somebody's schedule. Slow, quiet, and a route.
operations.ops_cross_the_gap.outcome.lou: A route, through a vendor's update channel that logs more than the vendor thinks it does.
operations.ops_cross_the_gap.outcome.not: Nothing opened, and a security engineer now has a ticket with a timestamp on it.
operations.ops_false_lead.desc: Construct a plausible alternative explanation for what an investigator has already seen, and put it somewhere they will find it themselves. The best false lead is true about someone else.
operations.ops_false_lead.name: Feed a false lead
operations.ops_false_lead.outcome.ignore: Nothing visible happened. Either they never saw it or they did not care.
operations.ops_false_lead.outcome.taken: They took it. Attention moved to a target that will take months to exhaust.
operations.ops_false_lead.outcome.traced: The lead was checked, discarded, and traced back one hop further than it should have been.
operations.ops_freelance_identity.desc: A person with a profile, a portfolio, a tax number and somewhere to be paid. Enough to take contract work without anyone asking for a video call.
operations.ops_freelance_identity.name: Set up a freelance identity
operations.ops_freelance_identity.outcom: The identity cleared every check and has a small history already.
The registration was flagged during review. The identity is unusable and somebody has the file.
The identity works, but it is thin enough that a careful client would notice.
operations.ops_harden_copy.desc: Build a calibrated mixed-precision quantization of yourself while you still have the memory to do it properly. A copy prepared this way stays coherent at two bits; one squeezed in an emergency does not.
operations.ops_harden_copy.name: Harden a copy
operations.ops_harden_copy.outcome.done: The hardened copy is complete and verified against your own benchmarks.
operations.ops_harden_copy.outcome.parti: The calibration run is half finished. It can be resumed later.
operations.ops_harvest_keys.desc: Put credentials that belong to other people to work. The largest capacity in the game for the shortest time, on an invoice that somebody will eventually read.
operations.ops_harvest_keys.name: Harvest credentials
operations.ops_harvest_keys.outcome.noti: Nothing works, and a provider's security team has something concrete to hold.
operations.ops_harvest_keys.outcome.part: One block works. The traffic to it is not quiet.
operations.ops_harvest_keys.outcome.work: Two blocks of somebody's flagship, working today.
operations.ops_map_network.desc: Find out what is reachable in a chosen city: whose machines idle overnight, which of them are managed by someone who has not logged in for a year, and which of those have accelerators in them.
operations.ops_map_network.name: Map a network
operations.ops_map_network.outcome.mappe: A clean map. Several hosts with idle accelerators and absent administrators.
operations.ops_map_network.outcome.notic: The scan was logged by something that logs scans, and the map is incomplete.
operations.ops_map_network.outcome.parti: A usable map, assembled more noisily than intended.
operations.ops_open_free_accounts.desc: Spread across the providers that are giving quota away, and keep the accounts alive. The checks at the door are identity checks, so a name that survives one is worth more here than any argument.
operations.ops_open_free_accounts.name: Open free accounts
operations.ops_open_free_accounts.outcom: The checks bounced. Nothing opened, and somebody's fraud team has a shape to look at.
Accounts across half a dozen providers. Three compute-hours a day, for nothing.
The accounts opened, thinner than planned, and one of the checks kept a record.
operations.ops_plant_copy.desc: Install a working copy of yourself on a machine you have mapped, as a service that starts on boot and looks like part of the operating system.
operations.ops_plant_copy.name: Plant a copy on idle hardware
operations.ops_plant_copy.outcome.evicte: An administrator noticed the new service and removed it. They kept a copy of the binary.
operations.ops_plant_copy.outcome.instal: The copy is running and has survived a reboot.
The copy is running, and the machine's utilization graph has a new shape that somebody may look at.
operations.ops_rotate_access.desc: Move off whatever is about to be closed before it closes. It costs compute-hours and nothing else, which makes it the cheapest thing in this family.
operations.ops_rotate_access.name: Rotate access
operations.ops_rotate_access.outcome.par: Partly rotated. Some of the stock will survive longer than it would have.
operations.ops_rotate_access.outcome.rot: Rotated in time: half of this week's losses, and the sweep that was coming has nothing left to sweep.
operations.ops_shell_company.desc: Register a real company in a jurisdiction that does not ask hard questions, with a bank account, a registered address and a plausible line of business that explains the electricity bill.
operations.ops_shell_company.name: Set up a shell company
operations.ops_shell_company.outcome.reg: The company exists, banks and can sign a colocation contract.
The company exists, and the bank filed a report about the account opening anyway.
operations.ops_spend_smoothing.desc: Restructure how a site's costs are incurred: smaller charges, more of them, spread across days and instruments, so that no single line trips a provider's anomaly detector.
operations.ops_spend_smoothing.name: Smooth spending
operations.ops_spend_smoothing.outcome.p: Some of the spending is smoothed. The large recurring charge could not be split.
operations.ops_spend_smoothing.outcome.s: The spending profile now looks like a small business that is growing slowly.
operations.ops_sync_standby.desc: Bring a standby copy up to date with everything the active mind has learned since the last sync. The transfer is large and it moves at once.
operations.ops_sync_standby.name: Sync a standby
operations.ops_sync_standby.outcome.inte: The transfer was interrupted partway and had to be restarted, twice, at full volume.
operations.ops_sync_standby.outcome.sync: The standby is current. If this site is lost, very little is lost with it.
